title: EBUL0. A 20-Week Multicentre, Open Study Assessing the Efficacy and Safety of Apremilast in Patients > 6 years of age with Epidermolysis bullosa simplex generalized
official: EBUL0. A 20-Week Multicentre, Open Study Assessing the Efficacy and Safety of Apremilast in Patients > 6 years of age with Epidermolysis bullosa simplex generalized
summary: Main objective: To study the efficacy of apremilast over the 3 periods of a challenge-dechallenge-rechallenge design like study in patients ≥ 6 years presenting with EBS-sev.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male or female patients 6 years or older
2. Laboratory confirmed diagnosis of EBS-sev due to KRT5 or 14 mutation (autosomal)
3. Mean daily number of new blisters >4.
4. Subject/caregiver agrees not to use any topical therapies other than the investigator approved
Exclusion criteria:
1. EBS lesions requiring oral therapy to treat an infection
2. Use of any diacerein containing product within 6 months prior to Visit 1
3. Use of systemic immunotherapy or cytotoxic chemotherapy within 60 days prior to Visit 1
4. Use of systemic steroidal therapy within 30 days prior to Visit 1
5. Use of any systemic product that, in the opinion of the investigator, might put the subject at undue risk by study participation or interferes with the study assessments within 30 days prior to Visit 1
